abstract: Decide whether to split LLM inference into prefill and decode pools, then configure and validate it. Covers vLLM NixlConnector and MooncakeConnector, SGLang --disaggregation-* flags, TensorRT-LLM cache_transceiver_config, NVIDIA Dynamo, llm-d, vLLM production-stack, AIBrix and the NIXL and Mooncake transports, with flags, defaults, constraints, failure behaviour and a concrete numerics gate through llm-evals. References split into engine flags, orchestrators, and when-it-helps plus gates.
